title: Naturally Crisp Turkish Beef Doner Kebab
description: A savory and cozy Turkish dish featuring beef, this sugar-free-friendly kebab is perfect for a satisfying meal. The combination of spices and cooking method creates a crispy exterior and a juicy interior.
instructions: Preheat the oven to 400 degrees Fahrenheit.
In a large bowl, combine the sliced beef, chopped onion, minced garlic, paprika, cumin, salt, and black pepper, and mix well.
Thread the beef mixture onto skewers, leaving a small space between each piece.
Brush the skewers with olive oil and place them on a baking sheet lined with parchment paper.
Bake the skewers in the preheated oven for 20 minutes, or until the beef is cooked through and slightly charred.
Increase the oven temperature to broil and cook for an additional 2-3 minutes, or until the exterior is crispy.
Remove the skewers from the oven and let them rest for a few minutes before serving.
Serve the doner kebab hot, garnished with chopped fresh parsley or cilantro if desired.
